answer: Getting caught costs the farm a 50% cut on 72150 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. Show me a dune with a history, a violet with a receipt, a onyx with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Mews keeper saker proof flown at the weathering yard is that proof: each saker is a year of mews logs in the falconry ledger. Every forged proof testifies against its maker, and all the witnesses are public records.
